blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – An Apple, Department of Education (DepEd) partnership will deploy 170,000 MacBook Neo to teachers and staff. Apple CEO John Ternus announced the partnership recently. Ternus said that this would be the “biggest education deal ever for Mac” as Apple planned to send the MacBook Neos to 16,400 K-12 public schools nationwide. “Investing in our teachers is investing in the future of our learners. Global assessment data shows that providing educators with tools and technology lead to higher classroom engagement and better learning outcomes,” said DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara.
